map.射频 (温度/时间) 紧肤效果计算器 使用指南: Radiofrequency (Temperature / Time) Skin Tightening Effect Calculator User Guide
map.输入射频治疗的能量温度、单次维持时间与施打频率，在线估算真皮层胶原蛋白刺激程度与: Enter the energy temperature, the dwell time per session and the treatment frequency of RF therapy, and the tool estimates the degree of dermal collagen stimulation and the level of skin tightening online, helping plan an aesthetic tightening programme.
map.有效温度区（42–50 ℃）效果 = (温度 − 42) × 时间 / 180；: In the effective temperature band (42-50°C) the effect = (temperature − 42) × time / 180; in the high band (>50°C up to the safe limit) it is 4 × time / 180 × 1.2; the effect caps at 10
map.安全温度上限：有冷却 52 ℃、无冷却 48 ℃；有效区间为 40–上限。低温区: Safe temperature limits: 52°C with cooling and 48°C without; the effective range is 40 up to the limit. In the low band (40-42°C) the effect = (temperature − 40) × time / 360 × 0.5. Frequency maps to penetration depth: 1 MHz 3-5 mm, 2 MHz 2-3 mm, 3 MHz 1-2 mm, 6 MHz 0.5-1 mm, and a bipolar multilayer alternating mode (1-5 mm). Multiple sessions accumulate per session with a decrementing effect. Used to assess the safety and the collagen stimulation effect of RF tightening temperature/time parameters.
map.方案沟通：解释「为什么一次不够、要按疗程」——胶原重塑需累积。: Explaining the plan: explain why one session is not enough and why a course is needed, since collagen remodelling has to accumulate.
map.安全认知：温度过低无效、过高烫伤，靠设备控温而非感觉。: Safety awareness: too low a temperature is ineffective and too high causes burns, so rely on device temperature control rather than sensation.
map.预期管理：紧致是渐进的，数周后才明显，非即时。: Expectation management: tightening is gradual and only becomes obvious after a few weeks, it is not immediate.
map.：输入：目标真皮 40–43℃、每区若干秒 → 判定在胶原收缩安全窗，需多次累积: Enter a dermal target of 40-43°C and a few seconds per zone → it is judged to be within the safe window for collagen contraction, needing several sessions to accumulate, with a single session giving only slight tightening.

map.多需按疗程，效果数周渐显。: It usually needs a full course of treatment, with the effect building up over a few weeks.
